messages:
maria: CI flagged a failing snippet in the runtime guide — looks like the example uses the old API `client.generate(...)` which now errors in our tests. failing job: https://ci.example.com/jobs/9887 :eyes:

deploy-bot: link-checker | runtime-guide/examples/generate.py failed with exit code 1

sam: ah yeah i noticed this in local smoke runs, simple migration is `client.text.generate(...)` instead of `client.generate`. someone want to open a one-line PR?

maria: opened one here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432 — updates the snippet and adds a note about pinning example versions. PTAL @docs-team :pray:

jen: small question — do we need to bump the runtime guide frontmatter `example_version` or are snippets pinned separately? worried about breaking older embedded references.

kevin: we already pin snippet embeds to v1.2 via the frontmatter in that guide. this PR only changes the snippet body. should be safe for existing embeds.

sam: :thumbsup: i'll review now. can we also add a tiny ci smoke test that runs the snippet so we don't regress again?

maria: added a pytest smoke test in the PR (tests/docs/test_snippets.py), simple import + mocked call, and a quick changelog blurb. hope that keeps link-check green.

docs-team: FYI i can add a grep job to the docs-ci to scan the repo for `client.generate(` occurrences and open-roll a migration checklist.

jen: :shipit: after sam's review and green ci, feel free to merge. thanks for the quick turnaround everyone!
